title: Canon EOS R5 Mark II Stacked Full-Frame
purpose: The Canon EOS R5 Mark II has it all, with both high-resolution 45MP images and high-resolution 8K video at an impressive 60p, paired with modern RF optical primes.

sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon RF 85mm F1.2L USM (9/13 elements, 9 circular blades)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14.8 stops dynamic range with 14-bit Dual Pixel RAW and 8K 60p RAW video recording
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic stacked focal-plane shutter with 1/250s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Flash-dominated studio strobe exposure, 1/250s sync, ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Key light 35 to 45 degrees off-axis slightly above eye line, minimal fill, deep negative fill flag on shadow side for high micro-contrast, low-power edge separation rim light

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and authentic Canon skin-tone color science
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, micro-abrasions, uncompressed highlight roll-off
High optical acutance without digital edge halos or unsharp masking artifacts
Clean editorial clarity without artificial smoothing, no diffusion, no haze
depth_and_optics: Focus locked on the near eye with iris and eyelashes tack sharp, absolute zero motion blur
Organic focus roll-off characteristic of high-acutance 85mm L-series glass at f/5.6
Zero perspective distortion, clean rectilinear projection

execution_directive: Enforce high-resolution stacked full-frame raw capture at 45MP and 8K 60p optical fidelity. Prioritize eye-tracking focus lock and negative fill contrast carving.
